points.why: Gives conditions for choosing Vensim vs Python and a stub test before committing, but no trigger for staying in the spreadsheet and no mention of escalation-of-commitment costs.
Requires reproducing the spreadsheet baseline in Vensim and then in PySD on identical settings, within tolerance, before trusting either.
Names mismatched time step and integration method (Euler, TIME STEP) as the main cause of differing numbers and includes a time-step halving test.
